subtitle: 用簡單的句子描述一個你最想過的週末
task: Describe your perfect weekend. Where would you go, who would you be with, and what would you do? Explain why it would make you happy.
taskZh: 描述你理想中的週末：去哪裡、和誰一起、做什麼，並說明為什麼這樣的週末會讓你開心。
focus: 清楚回答「去哪、和誰、做什麼、為什麼」
時態一致（用 would 描述想像的情境）
用連接詞讓句子更流暢

en: My perfect weekend would start slowly. On Saturday morning, I would sleep until nine and then have a big breakfast with my family. After that, I would ride my bike to the riverside park with my best friend. We would buy bubble tea and talk about everything.
On Sunday, I would visit the night market in the evening. Not only is the food cheap, but it is also delicious. I would try stinky tofu and grilled squid, and I would take a lot of photos.
This weekend would make me happy because I could rest, spend time with people I love, and enjoy simple things. In my opinion, a good weekend does not need to be expensive.
zh: 我理想的週末會從悠閒的早晨開始。星期六早上，我會睡到九點，然後和家人吃一頓豐盛的早餐。之後，我會和最好的朋友騎腳踏車到河濱公園。我們會買珍珠奶茶，無所不聊。
星期天傍晚，我會去逛夜市。那裡的食物不僅便宜，而且很好吃。我會嘗試臭豆腐和烤魷魚，還會拍很多照片。
這樣的週末會讓我開心，因為我可以休息、和我愛的人相處，並享受簡單的事物。在我看來，一個好的週末不需要花很多錢。

patterns.zh: 用 After that 串起事情的先後順序
patterns.example: After that, I would ride my bike to the riverside park with my best friend.

patterns.pattern: Not only is …, but it is also …
patterns.zh: 不僅……而且……（倒裝句，加強語氣）
patterns.example: Not only is the food cheap, but it is also delicious.

patterns.zh: 說明原因：……會讓我開心，因為……
patterns.example: This weekend would make me happy because I could rest, spend time with people I love, and enjoy simple things.
In my opinion, a good weekend does not need to be expensive.

parts: I would have a big breakfast with my family.
combine.answer: I would sleep until nine and then have a big breakfast with my family.
Not only is the food cheap, but it is also delicious.

paraphrase.sentence: A good weekend does not need to be expensive.
answers: You don't have to spend a lot of money to have a good weekend.
A great weekend can be cheap.
We would chat about anything and everything.
We would have long conversations about all kinds of things.
